name: Sheet
summary: Front Door's container inside the app: a modal dialog, centred on large screens and a bottom sheet on phones, with “One Atmosphere account for…” at its foot.

when: For every step of Front Door, inside the app.

whenNot.text: On provider pages, which are full pages.

anatomy.description: The sheet header, which stays put.
The step, which scrolls when tall.
The mark and “One Atmosphere account for Bluesky, [app] and every other Atmosphere app.”, which stays put.

props.name: label
props.description: Its accessible name: the current step's heading.

props.name: appName
props.description: The app's name, for the foot.

states.name: Tall content
states.description: The body scrolls; the header and foot stay put.

events.name: doras-close
events.when: It has closed: by Escape, the header's close button, or close(). Sent once, however it closed.

accessibility.name: Its label, the current step's heading.

keyboard.action: Moves through the sheet only; the page behind can't be reached.

keyboard.keys: Arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down
keyboard.action: Scroll the body, when it's tall enough to scroll and has focus.
Closes it, and returns focus to what opened it.

screenReader: Announced as a dialog with its label. The page behind is inert, so it can't be reached.
notes: The browser's modal dialog keeps focus in, makes the page inert, and returns focus to the opener on close.
When the body scrolls, it joins the Tab order so it can be scrolled from the keyboard. When it fits, it doesn't, so there's no empty Tab stop.
It uses dynamic viewport units, so the phone's on-screen keyboard doesn't hide its fields.
Its opening movement comes from the motion tokens, so it doesn't move for reduced motion.

guidelines: The foot always says the account works everywhere.

dosAndDonts.do: Return focus to Continue with Atmosphere when it closes.
dosAndDonts.dont: Leave focus at the top of the page.

evidence.point: The native dialog element's modal behaviour: focus containment, inert background and focus return.
